correctness.rationale: For k algebraically closed of characteristic 3, the verified RESULT.md gives Δ=U³+C²U²−C³(AD²+B²E)+AEC⁴, U=AE−BD. Direct symbolic differentiation verifies Jacobian vanishing on Q=(C,U) and the quadratic-square image V. The root-partition argument shows every discriminant quartic outside Q∪V has one ordinary double root with two distinct simple roots and is étale-locally a unit times the quadratic discriminant; since 4 is invertible, the hypersurface is smooth there. Q is the rank-one 2×2 Segre quadric image L³M, with degree-three Frobenius on the first P¹. The quadratic square map is a degree-four Veronese surface. Pullback of (C,U) to V is the single smooth conic (t²−su), yielding a scheme-theoretically reduced rational quartic L⁴ and the Frobenius graph. An independently implemented exact F3 check enumerated all 121 P⁴(F3) points and found 25 singular =16 Q +13 V−4 intersection. Finite points only cross-check the geometric proof.
